text: {"assessments":[{"key":"https://theverge.com/2026/8/8/agent-frameworks-long-tasks","usefulness":88,"angleStrength":91,"angle":"Long-running agents fail when the objective is treated as context instead of durable state."},{"key":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01234","usefulness":93,"angleStrength":94,"angle":"A larger context window is visibility; an external scratchpad is memory."},{"key":"https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=44821003","usefulness":72,"angleStrength":68,"angle":"The simplest reliable agent memory may be a checkpoint file."},{"key":"https://github.com/example/stateful-agent-loop","usefulness":86,"angleStrength":82,"angle":"Inspectable state is a debugging feature, not just persistence."},{"key":"evergreen:context windows are not durable memory","usefulness":90,"angleStrength":92,"angle":"Treat memory as architecture, not a model capability."},{"key":"evergreen:the cheapest abstraction is often a file","usefulness":80,"angleStrength":79,"angle":"A file can beat a service when the primary requirement is inspectability."}]}
